goal: Schritt 1: Zwei-Schritt-Prozess I59-I62 metrisch analysieren | Schritt 2: ausschließlich belegte Ineffizienzen durch atomare Step-Batches, CI-Pfad-Preflight und No-Fix-ohne-Statuscommit beheben

guide_delta.summary: Jeder der zwei Arbeitsschritte soll künftig als ein vollständiges Paket veröffentlicht werden. Nicht vorhandene Testdateien werden vorher erkannt, und wenn Schritt 2 nach grünem Check wirklich keine Änderung benötigt, entsteht kein künstlicher Zusatz-Commit.

tests_required: Schritt 1: metric audit records PR count, commit count, CI run count, file spread and patch volume for I59-I62
Zwischen-Gate: metrics/audit scope validates without product changes
Schritt 2: governance requires one atomic remote head per completed step
Schritt 2: no status-only step-2 commit when result is NO_FIX_REQUIRED and no versioned contract/freeze/evidence change is needed
Schritt 2: Manifest V2 validator rejects missing repository files in ci.compile and ci.python_tests
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because product code is untouched
TUI/browser/database regressions because runtime and frozen core are untouched
full suite because I63 is process governance only
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: atomic batching must not hide a failed intermediate gate; exactly one head per step still preserves the step-1 gate
NO_FIX_REQUIRED may skip a second commit only when no versioned product, contract, freeze or evidence change is required
file-existence validation must apply only to repository file targets and must not invent dependency checks
non_changes: no reduction of tests after a real step-2 product change
expected_side_effects: normal two-step iterations produce at most one planned remote head per step, plus explicit repair heads only after failed gates
pure no-fix step 2 produces no repository mutation and no duplicate CI run
invalid manifest CI file targets fail before targeted execution
